reviews.comment:
Lleve el auto para el service, los cambios todo ok, la forma de sacar turno ok. Pero por alguna razon no quieren, ni te dejan, abonar con la app de YPF (la cual ofrece ciertos descuentos). todo esto te lo avisan una vez que te presentaste al turno.

(Translated by Google)
I took the car in for service; the shifting was fine, and the appointment booking process was fine. But for some reason, they don't want to, or won't let you, pay with the YPF app (which offers certain discounts). They only tell you this once you arrive for your appointment.
